scope: All SCUMM engine games (MI1, MI2, Indiana Jones, DOTT, Sam & Max, etc.)

scummvm.description: Connect to ScummVM's built-in MCP server. Enable by setting mcp=true in scummvm.ini. Use mcp_port to override the default port (23456).

notes: The MCP server uses Streamable HTTP (MCP spec 2025-03-26). Sync tools (state) return immediately; streaming tools (act, answer, walk, skip, and the game-specific tools) open an SSE channel and emit notifications as dialog plays out, then return a structured result when the action completes. The exact tool set is engine- and game-dependent: query tools/list at runtime. Beyond the core tools, some games expose extra tools (see gameTools: play_note for Loom, shoot_cannon for COMI, ride_bike for Full Throttle, switch_character and dial for Maniac Mansion), and a set of diagnostic debugTools is registered only when mcp_debug=true.

initialize.description: Handshake. Client declares its protocol version; server replies with its capabilities and identity.

tools/list.description: List all MCP tools exposed by the engine.

tools/call.description: Invoke a tool. Sync tools (state) return immediately. Streaming tools (act, answer, walk, skip, and the game-specific tools) promote the connection to SSE and stream notifications before sending a final result.

params.name: string (core: state | act | answer | walk | skip; game-specific and debug tools listed under gameTools / debugTools — call tools/list for the live set)

tools.name: state
tools.description: Read the current game state: room, position, available verbs, inventory, visible objects, actors, buffered dialog lines, and any pending dialog question.

verbs.description: Verb names currently available in the UI (e.g. walk_to, look_at, pick_up)

inventory.description: Names of items in the player's inventory

state_name.description: Human-readable state, present only for objects that have one (e.g. a door's "opened"/"closed"). Omitted otherwise. Localised to the game's language.

objects.description: Objects visible in the current room

actors.description: Names of actors present in the current room

messages.description: Dialog lines buffered since the last state call (cleared on read)

question.description: Present only when a dialog choice is pending. Use the answer tool to respond.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Execute a verb on a named object or actor (by name or numeric ID from state). Streams SSE notifications as dialog plays out; returns a state-change summary when the action completes. For walking to pixel coordinates, use the walk tool instead.

verb.description: Verb to perform. Case-insensitive. Aliases: walk→walk_to, look→look_at, pick/pickup→pick_up, talk→talk_to.

oneOf.description: Primary target by name (from state.objects or state.actors)
Primary target by numeric object ID (from state.objects[].id)
Secondary target by name (for two-object verbs like use)
Secondary target by numeric object ID

examples.description: Walk to a named walk-box / hotspot
Talk to an actor, which returns a question with choices

choices.label: I want to be a pirate!

tools.name: answer
tools.description: Select a dialog choice by 1-based index. Only valid when state.question is present. Streams SSE notifications as the conversation plays out; returns a state-change summary when complete.

tools.name: walk
tools.description: Walk the player character to an explicit pixel coordinate. Out-of-bounds values are clamped to room bounds. Streams SSE notifications until the walk completes; returns a state-change summary.

x.description: Target X pixel coordinate (auto-clamped to [0, roomWidth-1])

y.description: Target Y pixel coordinate (auto-clamped to [0, roomHeight-1])

examples.note: Clamped to (roomWidth-1, 0) before the walk is issued

tools.name: skip
tools.description: Skip/cancel the current action or cutscene by simulating an Escape key press. Useful for skipping long intros or animations. Returns state changes.

gameTools.description: Tools registered only for specific games (in addition to the core tools). Always confirm availability via tools/list — they are absent for games that do not support them.

tools.name: play_note
tools.games: Loom; the Loom segment of Passport to Adventure
tools.description: Play Loom distaff notes. Accepts either {note:'c'} for one note, or {notes:['e','c','e','d']} to play a full sequence in one call. Only valid in the Loom segment (and full Loom). Note events played by the engine or the player are streamed as 'note' notifications.

note.description: Single note: one of c d e f g a b C (C is the high octave).

notes.description: Optional sequence of note strings to play in order, e.g. ['e','c','e','d'].

tools.name: shoot_cannon
tools.games: The Curse of Monkey Island (cannon minigame)
tools.description: Aim the cannon at screen position (x, y) and fire a cannonball. The skeleton war-canoes to sink are listed in state as boat_N objects with their (x, y); aim at one of those points. Blocks until the shot resolves (flight, explosion, any resulting speech), then returns state changes; a sunk boat disappears from state.objects.

x.description: Screen X to aim at (0–639); pass a boat's x from state.objects.

y.description: Screen Y to aim at (0–479); pass a boat's y from state.objects.

tools.name: ride_bike
tools.description: Play the Full Throttle motorcycle minigame. Available once Ben has the bike keys (from the bartender) and is at his bike at the bar front. Mounts the bike and rides onto the highway; the Rottwheeler fight runs as a real-time action sequence which this tool auto-plays. Takes no arguments. Blocks until the section ends, then returns state changes.

tools.name: switch_character
tools.description: Switch the player-controlled kid (the F1–F3 keys). state lists the available names in 'available_characters' and the current one in 'controlling'. Only allowed during normal gameplay. Blocks until the switch settles, then returns state changes (room_changed/position reflect the newly controlled kid).

name.description: Name of the kid to control, as listed in state.available_characters (e.g. 'dave').

tools.name: dial
tools.description: Dial a number on the phone dial pad. Only valid while the dial pad is on screen (use the phone first via act(verb='use', target1='phone')). Presses the keypad buttons one at a time, blocks until the sequence (and any resulting call) settles, then returns state changes.

number.description: Number to dial, as a string of keypad keys: digits 0-9 plus '*' and '#' (e.g. '1234').

debugTools.description: Diagnostic tools registered only when mcp_debug=true in the game's scummvm.ini section. Engine-version-agnostic unless noted. Intended for debugging and test-fixture authoring, not normal play; their results are free-form (no fixed outputSchema). keystroke/mouse_move/mouse_click run on the next engine frame.

tools.name: debug
tools.description: Return raw engine state for diagnostics: room id, ego position, _userPut, _mouse, _virtualMouse, _leftBtnPressed, _rightBtnPressed, _mouseAndKeyboardStat, _keyPressed, _currentRoom, plus a slice of SCUMM script vars (0..127 by default).

from.description: First SCUMM var index to return (default 0).

to.description: Last SCUMM var index to return (inclusive, default 127).

tools.name: keystroke
tools.description: Inject a keyboard keystroke into the engine (sets _keyPressed for the next frame). Useful for skipping cutscenes, opening menus, or game-specific shortcuts (the numpad 1-9 keys drive the Indy3 boxing minigame).

key.description: A single ASCII character ('a','C','1') or a name ('Escape','Return','Space','Tab','Backspace','F1'..'F12','Up','Down','Left','Right').

tools.name: mouse_move
tools.description: Move the virtual mouse cursor to (x, y) in room/screen coordinates. Updates _mouse, _virtualMouse, and VAR_VIRT_MOUSE_X/Y. Does not click.

tools.name: mouse_click
tools.description: Simulate a mouse click at (x, y), processed like a real player click (walks ego, runs verb script, etc.). Button defaults to left; set 'double' for a double click.

double.description: True for a double click (two clicks within ~250ms). Default false.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Save a PNG screenshot of the current frame to the configured screenshot path (auto-numbered, like the in-app screenshot key).

tools.name: save_state
tools.description: Save the current game to a save slot, the same way the in-game save menu does. Writes <target>.s<NN> in the active save path, so it can capture reusable save states for tests. Returns the slot and whether the save was accepted.

description.description: Optional label stored in the save header (default "mcp save").

tools.name: set_talk_speed
tools.description: Force the game's text/talk speed at runtime on the 0..255 scale used by --talkspeed (0 = slowest, 255 = fastest, instant text). Needed for titles whose boot script overrides the configured talkspeed (e.g. the Fate of Atlantis demo). Updates ConfMan and the live VAR_CHARINC.

speed.description: Talk speed on the 0..255 scale (0 = slowest, 255 = fastest).

stateChanges.description: State changes that occurred while the action ran

messages.description: Dialog lines spoken during the action

room_changed.description: New room number (only present if the room changed)

question.description: Present if a dialog choice is pending after the action
